texts.title: An Invitation to the Benches
texts.body: {whip.name} of {whip.house} asks you to dinner, and over the second course asks whether {self.house} has considered sitting with a bench. There are benches now in the Senate, houses that vote together and are counted together. A house alone has a vote. A bench has a say.

choices.hear_them_out: Hear {whip.him} out. A bench is a thing to be courted by.
choices.my_vote_is_my_own: My vote is my own. The chamber likes an independent.

texts.title: A Bench Takes Shape
texts.body: The Senate's clerks have a new name on their rolls, and {self.house} is on it: a bench of houses that have voted together often enough to be counted as one. You lead it, it has a record to make, and its houses lean the way you vote.

choices.a_dinner_for_the_bench: Give the bench a dinner. Five hundred credits.
choices.set_the_terms: Stand up and say what the bench is for. Oratory.

texts.title: The Whip's Displeasure
texts.body: {self.house} voted against its bench. The leader's note is short and the leader's regard is shorter. The bench will remember it at the count of the next motion {self.house} moves: every house of it leans a little against it.

choices.apologise: Apologise for the vote, and the bench lets it go. One influence, a little pride.
choices.stand_by_it: Stand by it to the bench's face. Proud.
choices.say_nothing: Say nothing. Let them decide what the silence means.

texts.title: The Bench Breaks
texts.body: The bench {self.house} sat with is no more, its houses have drifted, quarrelled or been counted on the other side too often. You sit alone again in a chamber that remembers who sat where.

choices.gather_the_remnant: Gather what is left and keep them talking (1 influence).
choices.sit_apart: Sit apart. Independence has a dignity.

texts.title: Across the Aisle
texts.body: A motion against {self.house} stands on the docket, and it was moved by the leader of a bench: every house of the bench leans the way its leader votes, and only one with a reason of its own will vote the other way. As the count stands it carries, unless something changes before the session.

choices.offer_a_deal: Cross the aisle with an offer (2 influence).
choices.split_the_bench: Find the bench's weakest member and what they want. Intrigue, 1 agent.
choices.face_them: Face the bench in open session.
